newsitem.title: FRANCE: No deadline to find Cr Foncier buyer.
newsitem.headline: No deadline to find Cr Foncier buyer.

text.p: French home loans lender Credit Foncier de France and the French finance ministry have not set a deadline for finding a buyer for the bank, chairman Jerome Meyssonnier said on Friday.
"It would be quite unfortunate to set a date when we do not know how long it will take," he told a news conference on the 1996 results. He gave no further details.
Credit Foncier said on Thursday it had appointed Deutsche Morgan Grenfell to help find a new owner.
The finance ministry this month decided to try again to find a purchaser for the bank, on the advice of state-appointed mediator Philippe Rouvillois.
Meyssonnier estimated the bank needed between 2.5 billion and three billion francs in fresh capital to bring its tier one risk capital back to eight percent.
Finance Director Regis de Larouillere had previously estimated the need at between two billion and 2.5 billion francs. It currently has 3.8 billion in shareholders funds and latent capital gains.
Credit Foncier reported on Thursday 1996 consolidated profit of 858 million francs, after posting 1995 losses of 10.6 billion.
